description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I: Ace] and [Fire Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Fire Mode I: Ace
description.text: Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Fira RF after casting an equipped Fire ability

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Fire Mode II: Ace], removes [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I: Ace]
